candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s), causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment POST erroring while inventory/redis succeed, so the latency originates at the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/logs admitted; payment internal cause (pool, GC, network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with ~2s ReadTimeouts on payment authorization calls in traces; inventory/redis succeed and gateway metrics show only /v1/checkout 502s with p95 ~2.4s. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and logs to confirm payment-side saturation
Payment dependency topology (e.g., DB) to localize the timeout origin
